<span>Country-specific policy context</span>
<small>1 note</small>
</summary>
<div class="country-note-group__body">
<div class="country-note-item">
<h4>Policy note</h4>
<p>Costa Rica has implemented tafenoquine, being the first country in Central America and the Carribbean implementing tafenoquine. Tafenoquine is the first choice for treatment of G6PD normal individuals. If not available use of PQ high dose If G6PD testing is not available, healthcare providers can refer the patient to a health facility that has testing as long as testing and treatment can be within 24hrs.</p>
</div>
</div>
</details>
